title: Reservation detail blocks (res_detail_tab_content.dart) - part 1 of 3 (G-438..G-450; mainly res_detail_tab_content.dart, res_modification_history.dart, paid_change_banner.dart)

guards.situation: A paid swap or edit failed permanently (e.g. server refused); the customer is told what happened and what happens to the extra payment (refund), and the banner stays until they confirm 'Rozumím'.
guards.customer_sees: Red box '! <title>' with the reason and refund sentence and a 'Rozumím' button.
guards.server: yes(refusal reason comes from split_booking_moto_swap / the paid-change apply path)
guards.verdict_evidence: Same failure detection, same texts, same ack callback; v2 shows them as an error-tone banner with an inline text button.
